hero.title: Websites, apps and *AI solutions* that bring you clients

home.aboutText: We take the project end to end: research, design, development, launch and support. No middlemen and no lost context — you talk directly to the people building your product.

brief.title: Brief
brief.text: We discuss the task, audience and goals.
brief.detail: A call or chat — whatever works. We define goals, audience and budget, and agree on success criteria.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.text: Scope, cost and timeline — fixed and transparent.
estimate.detail: The calculator gives a range instantly; a detailed proposal with stages lands the same day.

design.title: Design
design.text: We design the interface and approve the layouts.
design.detail: Prototype first, then screens in a single design system. Revisions until sign-off.

build.title: Build
build.text: We write the code and show progress every week.
build.detail: Weekly demos on a live staging. The code lives in your repository from day one.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: We deploy, test and hand over the project.
launch.detail: Domain, analytics, SEO basics. One month of post-launch support included.

about.title: About us
about.intro: Skyline Digital is a full-cycle studio based in Tashkent. We design, build and launch digital products for clients worldwide.
about.p1: We are a small team, and that is our advantage: you talk directly to the people building your project. No account managers in between and no context lost between departments.
about.p2: We follow a clear process: scope and cost are fixed before we start, progress is shown weekly, and the project ships with documentation and support.

v1.title: Transparent estimates
v1.text: Cost is computed by rules, not by gut feeling — you see exactly what the price is made of.

v2.title: Speed without cutting corners
v2.text: A modern stack and a refined process let us ship fast.

v3.title: Product over code
v3.text: We think in your metrics: leads, sales, retention — not just technology.
